_doc: A SATURATED SETUP DOCUMENT for the preservation corpus, in canonical test
JSON rather than SVG.
WHY NOT AN SVG, like every other vector's setup. The SVG codec has no
counterpart for a mask, a blend mode or a stroke alignment, and no port
writes a jas: extension for the two gradients, the stroke brush or the
width profile (test_fixtures/expected/codec_field_survival.json, `svg`
column). preservation_nested_attrs.svg says so in its own header: 'Deliberately
NOT set: mask, blendMode ... the SVG reader populates none of them, so writing
them here would produce a fixture that silently asserts nothing.' A corpus
whose only door is SVG can therefore never place a mask or a blend mode on a
BYSTANDER -- which is precisely the class transcripts/EDIT_SEMANTICS_FREEZE.md
T4 exists to watch, and precisely what Swift's container rebuilds destroy.
The canonical test JSON is the codec that now carries all twelve, so it is
the door that can express the setup the law needs.
WHAT IS SATURATED, and for whose sake:
grp_masked  -- a CONTAINER bystander carrying a mask (with an inverted,
unlinked, transformed subtree) and a blend mode. It is the
shape of Swift's `withChildren` / inline-container-literal
class: rebuild the group to reach the child inside it and
the mask and mode go with it.
p_dashed    -- a LEAF bystander carrying every remaining watched field:
blend mode, tool origin, fill rule, an inside-aligned dashed
stroke with anchor alignment and a non-default miter limit,
a width profile, a stroke brush and its overrides, and both
gradients.
msk_rect    -- the mask's own artwork. It is NOT a document element (the
invariant walk does not descend into `mask`), so it is
compared as part of grp_masked's attribute blob.
The vector that uses this file names `bystander_fields_present`, so a setup
that silently decayed to defaults reds the gate instead of passing on
nothing -- the document-level form of section 3.1's anti-vacuity guard.
STOP COLOURS ARE RGB HEX-EXPRESSIBLE, deliberately: jas_dioxus holds a
gradient stop colour as a Color and JasSwift as a `#rrggbb` String, so a
shared fixture can only carry what BOTH can hold.
